title: Rationale for Stopping Park and Ride Scheme
what_it_is: Rationale for Stopping Park and Ride Scheme

sections.label: Park and Ride scheme objective
sections.summary: The Park and Ride scheme aims to reduce CBD traffic congestion by encouraging motorists to switch to public transport, but has low take-up.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The objective of the Park and Ride scheme is to reduce traffic congestion in the central business district (CBD) by encouraging motorists to switch to public transport just before entering the CBD.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: It was introduced long ago in 1975, before our Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) system was built, and when the public transport network was also much less extensive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Today, many commuters are able to take the MRT and buses directly to the city from their homes which, therefore, makes the Park and Ride Scheme much less useful.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Indeed, over the past few years, the take-up rate for the scheme has been consistently low, very low.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: There are fewer than 2,000 regular users, most of whom do not take public transport after parking their cars.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: This suggests that a good number of motorists are using the Park and Ride scheme as cheap, subsidised destination parking.

sections.label: Savings for motorists parking outside CBD
sections.summary: Motorists parking at the Sports Hub or Kallang and taking public transport could save up to a few hundred dollars monthly, so no further subsidies are needed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Motorists who park at the Sports Hub or at Kallang, for example, and take public transport, could see savings of up to a few hundred dollars monthly, as they do not have to pay the much more expensive season parking in the CBD nor Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) charges.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: There is no need for taxpayers to provide further subsidies.
